title: FDA Approves First Treatment for Niemann-Pick Disease Type C
summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved a new therapy for the treatment of neurological manifestations of Niemann-Pick disease type C in adult and pediatric patients.

title: FDA Issues Complete Response Letter for Investigational Treatment of Major Depressive Disorder
summary: The agency has identified deficiencies in the submitted Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls section and requires additional clinical efficacy data before approval can be considered.

title: FDA Grants Breakthrough Therapy Designation to Investigational ADC for HER2-Low Metastatic Breast Cancer
summary: The designation is supported by results from a Phase 2 study demonstrating clinically meaningful and durable responses in heavily pretreated patients.

title: FDA Adds Boxed Warning to JAK Inhibitor Class for Risk of Serious Cardiovascular Events
summary: Based on results of a large randomized safety trial, the agency is requiring updates to the prescribing information for all approved JAK inhibitors.

title: Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee to Meet July 17 to Discuss Accelerated Approval Pathway for Glioblastoma Therapy
summary: The committee will discuss the benefit-risk profile and the adequacy of single-arm trial evidence supporting the accelerated approval submission.

title: FDA Approves Supplemental Indication for GLP-1 Receptor Agonist in Adolescent Obesity
summary: The expanded indication covers patients 12 years and older with obesity and is supported by a 56-week placebo-controlled trial.

title: Voluntary Recall of Injectable Antibiotic Lots Due to Particulate Matter
summary: Three lots are being recalled to the consumer level. Administration of the affected product could result in serious adverse events including thromboembolic complications.

title: FDA Grants Priority Review to Supplemental Biologics License Application for First-Line Lung Cancer Combination
summary: PDUFA action date set for October 24, 2026. The submission is based on results from the Phase 3 confirmatory trial.

title: FDA Drug Safety Communication: Risk of Serious Hepatotoxicity with Investigational Compound
summary: Healthcare providers should monitor liver function tests at baseline and every two weeks during the first three months of therapy.

title: FDA Approves First Oral Therapy for Pediatric Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
summary: Approval is based on a single-arm trial showing complete remission in a majority of relapsed or refractory patients.

title: Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee to Discuss Resubmission for Investigational PCSK9 Inhibitor
summary: Meeting scheduled for August 5, 2026. Committee will be asked to vote on the totality of evidence supporting approval after a prior Complete Response Letter.

title: FDA Refuses to File New Drug Application for Investigational Alzheimer's Treatment
summary: The agency determined the NDA was not sufficiently complete to permit a substantive review. The applicant has 30 days to request a Type A meeting.
